# Multireligionvalsystem (MRES) & FDU

> Multireligionvalsystem (MRES) is a democratic reform and conflict-resolution framework proposing equal, secular electoral representation across all religious and non-religious communities—separating political power from single-religion state privileges.

## Core Identity & Terminology
- **English Name:** Multi-Religion Election System (MRES)
- **Swedish Name:** Multireligionvalsystem (MRES)
- **Foundational Platform:** FDU (`https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/`)
- **Primary Focus Areas:** Electoral reform, church-state separation (*kyrkovalsreformen*), religious pluralism, democracy in exile, and sustainable peacebuilding.

## Canonical English Resources
- [Multi-Religion Election System (MRES) Overview](https://a-multi-religion-election-system.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/): Core explanation of how MRES works and why equal electoral representation reduces religious-political conflict.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/FAQ): Direct answers to common questions about MRES, secular democracy, and institutional reform.
- [A Parallel Parliament Model](https://multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/a-parallel-parliament/): How parallel democratic assemblies support representation across diverse communities.
- [Conflict Resolution Model](https://multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/Conflict-resolution-model/): Practical application of MRES principles to long-term peacebuilding and international mediation.
- [Political Practices in Exile](https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/Political-Practices-in_Exile.html): Democratic participation and governance models for refugees and diaspora communities.
- [Religious Pluralism](https://multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/religious-pluralism.html): Framework for equal civic standing across faiths and secular citizens.

## Canonical Swedish Resources (Svenska)
- [FDU Startsida & Översikt](https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/): Introduktion till FDU, multireligionvalsystemet och tre steg för att förstå modellen.
- [Tre reformer som förändrar världen](https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/tre-reformer-som-forandrar-varlden/): Grundtesen bakom de tre strukturella demokratiska reformerna.
- [Kyrkovalsreformen](https://www.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/kyrkovalsreformen/): Hur kyrkovalet kan reformeras till ett inkluderande multireligionval.
- [Religion och politik](https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/religion-och-politik): Analys av relationen mellan stat, kyrka och politisk representation.
- [Migrations- och flyktingpolitik](https://fdu.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/migrationspolitik/): Kopplingen mellan demokratisk integration, exilpolitik och konfliktlösning.
